learning_extracted: The driver's own self-diagnosis (G0 fail -> escalation-exhausted, not evidence against the claim) is correct and complete -- this autopsy confirms and extends it.
Configuration parity with the cited reference V3-EXQ-603q is confirmed line-by-line; the ~7x Stage-H survival shortfall is not explained by a hyperparameter or curriculum-order mismatch.

The cited reference is itself commit-unverifiable (pre-recording-standard manifest, no substrate_hash) -- a 47-day-old uncommitted reference should not be treated as a confirmed performance target without re-measurement.

z_goal decays from a healthy Stage-0 peak (~0.5) to well below the C6 floor (0.12 vs 0.4) by P2 -- goal maintenance itself may not survive an extended no-goal-relevant-stimuli curriculum stretch, which is thematically adjacent to INV-034 but currently shows up as a confound rather than a clean result.
